description.zh:
将要发布的Env环境。

> - production：环境名称，包含SpecName（环境名称）和AllowedHosts（域名白名单）。
> - presetCanary：选填，根据您业务需要添加的灰度环境。
description.en:
The environment to which you want to publish the code.

> - production: The name of the production environment. It includes SpecName (environment name) and AllowedHosts (domain name whitelist).
>
> - presetCanary: Optional. The grayscale environment that you can add as needed.

description.zh: 边缘函数名, 同一个账号下命名唯一。
description.en: The name of the Edge Routine. The name must be unique within an Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh: 将要发布的边缘函数ER代码版本。
description.en: The version of the Edge Routine (ER) code to publish.

title.zh: 发布指定版本的边缘函数ER代码到某个Env环境

descriptions.en: > The API call frequency is 100 calls per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn publish-routine-code-revision --name test --select-code-revision 1620876959997924701 --envs '[production, presetCanaryZhejiang]' --region cn-hangzhou
